title: Rescue plan: helm values schema bump caused API gateway 503s during private cluster upgrades
creator: Ava Lin
description:
Summary:
During the 2026-03 rolling upgrade window for private/VPC clusters we shipped a Helm values schema bump (runtime-1.20) that changed the api_gateway.values layout and introduced a new required field (APIGW_ENV_MODE). On several older customer clusters with customized helm values, Helm attempted to apply the chart but Kubernetes API rejected the live update for the api-gateway Deployment due to an immutable field change combined with a missing env injection. The operator entered a reconcile loop: Helm upgrade partially completed, CR status flipped to 'UpgradePending' and then repeated leader election retries. Observed customer-facing symptom: sustained 503s from the API gateway for 4–22 minutes depending on cluster size.

Root cause hypothesis and confirmation steps:
- Schema bump added APIGW_ENV_MODE and moved a nested key under .global.networking; our helm templating assumes the new structure and renders empty strings when the older flattened keys are present (config drift scenario).
- Helm's upgrade succeeded for most resources, but the api-gateway Deployment update hit an immutable field constraint (we changed the name of a mounted Secret key used by the readiness probe), causing the controller to leave pods in CrashLoopBackOff until operator auto-roll logic attempted to restart them.
- Operator's upgrade reconciliation does not currently run a values-migration step when it detects a chart schema_version mismatch; instead it tries to apply new manifests which can leave clusters in a partially-upgraded state.

Customers impacted (escalations):
- acme-analytics (prod cluster: acme-prod-eu)
- finDataCorp (staging cluster: fd-stg-us)
- two additional small customers (support tickets #5421, #5423)

Immediate mitigations applied (timeline):
- 2026-03-10 09:18 UTC: throttled upgrade wave and paused all remaining onprem upgrade jobs (SRE decision).
- 2026-03-10 09:34 UTC: pushed a temporary helm patch (chart annotation change) to force a restart of api-gateway pods without changing immutable fields; applied to impacted clusters as a hotpatch — shortened outage for acme-analytics to 6 minutes.
- 2026-03-10 11:02 UTC: created a targeted operator hotfix branch with values-migration hook and safer helm upgrade logic (operator v0.33.3). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4723

Planned permanent fix (workstreams):
1) Values migration step: operator will detect chart schema_version mismatches and run migration transforms on customer helm values (idempotent patch under a new subresource) before applying new manifests.  (ENG-83456-W1)
2) Helm upgrade strategy change: implement server-side dry-run + validation pass and an explicit safe-delete/rollover path for Deployments that require immutable field updates. (ENG-83456-W2)
3) Config drift detector: expand existing drift scanner to flag deprecated/legacy api_gateway keys during pre-flight and surface warnings in Console. (ENG-83456-W3)
4) Runbook and alerting: update Runbook (Confluence) and pager thresholds to detect stuck upgrades earlier and notify onprem escalation channel. (ENG-83456-W4)

Release plan for the operator hotfix:
- Merge PR to main with tests (unit + integration) and a migration runner: target merge by 2026-03-15.
- Canary rollout: stage -> 3 internal dedicated clusters -> 2 low-risk customer onprem clusters -> broad private rollout over 48h.
- Post-deployment verification: ensure api-gateway pod restarts succeed, readiness probes green, and no Helm 'pending' CR statuses remain.

Observability and tests added:
- Dashboard: upgrade-reconcile-duration (new Grafana panel), api-gateway-503-rate by cluster.
- E2E: added a Helm schema mismatch scenario in the upgrade test harness that simulates legacy values and validates migration path.

Documentation/runbooks and tickets linked:
- Runbook (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/Onprem+Upgrade+Rescue+Runbook
- Hotpatch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4723
- Helm chart MR (chart repo): https://gitlab.redwood.com/charts/runtime/merge_requests/198

Next steps (owner: Sofia Martinez):
- Complete code changes for values migration and helm dry-run by 2026-03-14 (in progress).
- Coordinate canary patch for 2 low-risk customers on 2026-03-16 (SRE and Solutions Eng).
- Create follow-up customer communications and a postmortem to be shared by 2026-03-22.
